note: Claude draft (unchecked). Water areas are Edo Bay and the Hibiya Inlet before reclamation, as approximate polygons over today's terrain, each with t1 = the year it became land; Edo-period shorelines follow Naito (2003) and the standard reclamation sequence, 20th-century fills are dated to their completion roughly. Extents are approximate built-up areas by period, cut so they never overlap water alive in the same year. Gates and moats are placed on surviving sites where they exist.
